Pinned subset of Frenkel Smeijers' Doom8088:
https://github.com/FrenkelS/Doom8088
Commit b3073a2eb2811cd14caba6549694fc3bfcd6dd29.

Only headers, r_draw.c, tables.c and LICENSE are included. Only trailing whitespace and final blank lines are normalized; upstream
code and notices are otherwise unchanged. Generated adaptations live in the build directory; see
scripts/doom_renderer.py and docs/doom-renderer.md. Copyright and licence
notices are retained. No Doom IWAD is included.
